nosy-iranja.description: Two islands joined by a white sandbar the tide uncovers. Set off by dhow at sunrise, sail back as the sun goes down.

nosy-tanikely.description: The archipelago's finest snorkelling spot: green turtles, coral gardens and clownfish just metres from the shore.

lokobe.description: The island's last primary rainforest, reached by traditional pirogue. Black lemurs, boas and chameleons with a local guide.

mont-passot.description: The island's highest point and its crater lakes. This is where you watch the sun set over the archipelago.

circuits.pageIntro: Two-to-eleven-day trips to discover northern Madagascar differently: primary forest, fishing villages, SAVA vanilla and the islands of the archipelago. Every itinerary is designed and guided by our local team.

les-circuits-nord-de-madagascar-11jours-.title: The North of Madagascar
les-circuits-nord-de-madagascar-11jours-.summary: Eleven days across the whole north: the red tsingy, Diego Bay, vanilla plantations and the Nosy Be archipelago. Our most complete itinerary.

circuit-nature-traditions-du-nord-8-jour.title: Nature & Traditions of the North
circuit-nature-traditions-du-nord-8-jour.summary: Eight days between nature reserves and Sakalava villages. Meetings with local craftspeople, local markets and homestay nights.

circuit-sava.title: SAVA Tour
circuit-sava.summary: The vanilla route and Marojejy park. A region still untouched by mass tourism, between the Indian Ocean and rainforest.

tours-des-archipels-de-nosy-be.title: Nosy Be Archipelago Tour
tours-des-archipels-de-nosy-be.summary: Four days sailing between Nosy Iranja, Nosy Komba and Nosy Sakatia. Snorkeling, sandbanks and sunsets aboard a traditional boat.

une-experience-authentique.title: An Authentic Experience
une-experience-authentique.summary: Three days at village pace: dawn fishing, Sakalava cooking and a musical evening. Off the beaten tourist track.

randonnees-immersive-a-nosy-komba.title: Immersive Hike on Nosy Komba
randonnees-immersive-a-nosy-komba.summary: Two days of hiking on Lemur Island, from Ampangorina village to the summit. Homestay night and meeting with local embroiderers.

circuit-2-jours-a-lokobe.title: 2 Days at Lokobe
circuit-2-jours-a-lokobe.summary: The island's last stretch of primary forest, reached by traditional dugout canoe. Two days spotting black lemurs, boas and chameleons with a village guide.
